bases.name: Guardian Flight / GFL 214 – Escanaba, MI
bases.limitation: Approximate publicly mapped helipad center on the OSF St. Francis Hospital campus, checked against aerial imagery. The hospital confirms Guardian hangar and crew on campus. The off-campus directory coordinate is not used; this is not a surveyed aircraft parking position.

sources.purpose: Current public operator directory identifies this program.

Public September 2026 membership directory cross-check; contacts not reproduced.
Hospital confirms Guardian flight crew and hangar on its campus.
Public helipad footprint; mean of four unique vertices used as approximate pad center.
Aerial inspection confirms mapped pad adjacent to hospital and hangar.

bases.name: Guardian Flight / GFL 228 – Gaylord, MI
bases.limitation: Published estimated FAA airport reference for Gaylord Regional Airport (GLR). GMR and a 2026 airport visit confirm the airport base; exact current hangar is unestablished. Operator directory uses GFL 228 while a public membership list uses 73; one program is mapped. The residential directory point is not used.

bases.name: FlightCare / Med-Trans 242 – Saginaw, MI

finding: Five publicly corroborated Michigan GMR programs: two rotor-wing and three fixed-wing. Current directory and state inventory agree on the five cities. Gaylord number discrepancy is retained explicitly, not turned into duplicate bases.

limitations: Facility/heliport references are approximate, not surveyed parking locations. Gaylord uses the airport reference; exact hangars at Gaylord, Houghton and Iron Mountain remain unestablished.
Generalized county boundaries are not cadastral surveys.
Neighboring states remain incompletely reviewed during rollout.
Fixed-wing-only programs remain visible but are excluded from county-click coverage results.
Uniform 75 NM geographic rings do not guarantee operational range, flight availability, membership eligibility or service.
